---
title: "Validation: energy units"
---

An example validation document. It runs the package on a known case and
compares with a reference value, so a wrong result shows up here and fails the
render. Replace it with validations of your own code.

The H₂ ground-state energy in the Born–Oppenheimer approximation is
−1.17447 hartree (Kołos & Wolniewicz). In electronvolts that is about −31.96 eV.

```{python}
from mypackage.units import hartree_to_ev

e_h2 = hartree_to_ev(-1.17447)
print(f"H2 ground-state energy: {e_h2:.3f} eV")

assert abs(e_h2 - (-31.959)) < 1e-3, "unit conversion disagrees with reference"
```
